what: Fact Magazine reports that Al Riwaq Art Space opened its 2026 programme with Ola Saad Znad's exhibition A Homeland Adrift Upon the Waters, on from 20 January to 26 March.

also.what: The space's own site lists upcoming programming for sale, among it The Majal Programme: Third Edition, workshops and an open mic night; the listings carry no dates.

what: New Daily, citing a Channel A broadcast of 21 June 2021, reports that the Mansudae Art Museum in the 798 district was open and selling works, and staff said everything on show was for sale. No page opened states that the gallery closed for good.

also.what: A Koryo Group blog post dated 7 February 2019 says the 798 showing of North Korean art was closed at that time because of sanctions; it does not say the closure was permanent, and the 2021 report shows the gallery trading after it.

what: Novaya Gazeta, on 9 June 2026, reports that Fabrika opened in May the second part of an exhibition about the possible loss of its space, after the site was put on Moscow's list for comprehensive redevelopment in October 2025 with housing planned there. The article calls the centre closing and gives no closing date.
quote: Теперь, в мае, «Фабрика» представила вторую часть истории

also.what: KudaGo lists the exhibition Service room at Perevedenovsky pereulok 18 from 11 December 2025 to 24 January 2026.

what: MOWAA's own site carries news posts dated through 2026, the latest on 26 November 2026, among them a residency announcement of 11 November 2026 and an October 2026 news bulletin. The site says visits are by appointment only.
quote: Visits to MOWAA are by appointment only.

what: The Muse multi studios' own site announces an art writing workshop series for its Sudan Art Archive project, held on 27 to 29 June and 5 to 6 July, with an application deadline of 20 June 2026.
quote: Sudan Archive of Fine Arts project by The Muse multi studios, with funding from AFAC

what: The documenta fifteen page lists Nha San Collective's events from 19 June to 25 September 2022, in Kassel and in Ngoc Thuy, Hanoi. The collective's own news page stops at October 2021 and its about page reads 2013 to present with no current address. No page opened states that it ended.
quote: Throughout the summer a series of events takes place in Ngọc Thuỵ, Hanoi

also.what: The newest item on the collective's own news page is dated 10 October 2021.
The about page lists the collective as 2013 to present, says it works with or without a physical base, and gives Hanoi Creative City, 2016 to 2017, as its last listed address.

what: State of Concept's own homepage states that its physical space in Athens is permanently closed. The Internet Archive copy of 2 December 2024 is the earliest one checked that carries the notice; the copy of 2 September 2024 still showed the group show Care Ecologies, open by appointment until 14 September 2024. The site lists no later exhibition or event and no new venue.
quote: State of Concept's physical space in Athens is permanently closed.

also.what: The live homepage on 28 November 2026 carries the same notice and an empty agenda.
The copy of 2 September 2024 shows Care Ecologies, July to 14 September 2024, with the line Open by appointment until 14.09.2024.
